settings.heading: Wellness Technology, Explained Simply.
settings.body:
Healthy Sleep Space Low-Intensity Photon-Generators (LIPG) are designed as optional, noninvasive components of a general-wellness routine.

They may be incorporated into rest, relaxation, meditation, quiet reading, or other stated wellness activities.
settings.disclaimer: General wellness only. Not medical advice or medical care.

settings.title: Your Routine
settings.text: Build a consistent wind-down and create time for rest.

settings.title: Our Technology
settings.text: LIPG devices create a low-intensity photon environment.

settings.title: Your Environment
settings.text: A dark, quiet, and comfortable space supports your routine.

settings.eyebrow: How It Fits Into Your Routine
settings.heading: Technology in Service of Your Wellness
settings.body: Healthy Sleep Space technology is designed to create a low-intensity photon environment during appropriate use. It is one element that can complement your consistent nighttime routine and comfortable sleep environment.

settings.title: What Is a Photon?
settings.text: Photons are particles of light energy that exist across a range of wavelengths. Specialized instruments can be used to measure and describe light.

settings.title: What Does Low-Intensity Mean?
settings.text: Low-intensity refers to the level of photon emissions produced by the device. Product-specific measurements are important for understanding output.

settings.title: How We Characterize Our Products
settings.text: We use specialized instruments to measure and describe physical characteristics, including emission spectrum, radiometric output, surface temperature, and system verification.

settings.heading: Key Concepts
settings.disclaimer: These descriptions relate to physical product characteristics only. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, mitigate, or prevent any disease.

settings.custom_text: Support your nighttime routine right where you sleep.
Enhance quiet-time practices like reading, meditation, or reflection.
Use in bedrooms, living rooms, wellness spaces, and other comfortable environments.
Bring your routine with you when traveling or resting away from home.
Choose curated product combinations that complement your routine.
